routes.label: replacement, as for a new passport

note: Tuvalu's Passports Regulations in the 2022 Revised Edition on the Attorney General's legislation site (read 2026-11-03): a new passport costs 50 Australian dollars and is valid 5 years; it may be renewed once for up to 5 more years at 20 dollars, and it ceases 10 years after first issue (the game keeps the renewal as a route, not the cap); a replacement costs as a new passport. A child under 18 may be included in a parent's passport (10 dollars an endorsement, not modelled) or have one of their own with a parent's consent, at the same fee. The investor passport of Part B (15,000 US dollars) and the emergency passport aren't modelled. The fee schedule dates from LN 8/2003, the latest amendment the edition carries; no processing time is published.

sources.title: Tuvalu Legislation, Passports Regulations, Cap. 24.20.1, 2022 Revised Edition (GN 10/1980, as amended by LN 10/1994, LN 1/1999 and LN 8/2003), regulations 3 and 4 and Schedule 2
sources.said: 3 (3) A Tuvalu Passport will only be issued to a person under the age of 18 years on proof that the parent or guardian of such person consents to such issue. ... 4 (1) A Tuvalu Passport shall be valid and current for 5 years from the date of issue in the first instance ... (2) A Tuvalu Passport may be renewed from the date of its expiry for a period not exceeding 5 years upon application in accordance with regulation 9. ... (3) At the end of 10 years from the date of first issue of a Tuvalu Passport ... the passport shall cease to be valid. ...
